words.def: to make a process simpler, faster and cheaper by removing unnecessary steps.
words.book: Our fulfillment process is designed to streamline the order fulfillment process, reducing the time and cost involved in getting products to customers.
uses: Email
Our new ticketing system will streamline how we handle UPS service calls.
Chat
we need to streamline the quotation approvals, 3 signatures is too much 😅
Meeting
By streamlining the spare-parts process, we cut our response time by two days.
dont: We want to make the process more easy and fast.
doo: We want to streamline the process.

words.ar: متفصّل على مقاس / مناسب بالظبط لاحتياج
words.def: designed or changed to fit the exact needs of a particular customer.
words.book: Turning to our next point, which is pricing: at Streamline Fulfillment, we offer competitive pricing options that are tailored to the specific needs of each client.
uses: Email
Please find attached a maintenance proposal tailored to your data-centre requirements.
Chat
can we tailor the solar offer to their budget? they won't go above 2M
Meeting
Every battery solution we propose is tailored to the customer's load and backup time.
dont: We make a special offer on your size.
doo: We'll prepare an offer tailored to your needs.

words.def: giving good results for the money you spend.
words.book: We work with a network of trusted partners to provide reliable and cost-effective shipping solutions to our clients worldwide.
uses: Email
Lithium batteries cost more upfront but are more cost-effective over ten years.
Chat
refurbishing the old UPS might be more cost-effective than replacing it tbh
Meeting
We're looking for the most cost-effective way to cover all three branches.
dont: This solution is economic for the money.

words.def: to accept a lower standard of something in order to save money or time.
words.book: Our commitment to affordable pricing does not mean that we compromise on quality.
uses: Email
We can reduce the price by using a local brand, but we won't compromise on battery quality.
Chat
cheaper cables = compromising on safety. not doing it 🙅
Meeting
We can adjust the payment terms, but we can't compromise on the service level.
dont: We will not make a discount on the quality.
doo: We will not compromise on quality.

words.def: being open and clear, with nothing hidden — especially about prices and costs.
words.book: We also believe in transparency when it comes to pricing.
uses: Email
For full transparency, the quotation lists labour and spare parts separately.
Chat
let's be transparent with the client about the delay
Meeting
Transparency on pricing is what keeps our corporate clients with us.
dont: We are clear and nothing under the table.

words.def: a question you ask to get information, often from a customer to a company.
words.book: Can you handle returns and customer service inquiries?
uses: Email
Thank you for your inquiry about our UPS maintenance contracts.
Chat
got 3 inquiries about solar inverters from the exhibition 👀
Meeting
Our call centre handles all service inquiries within 24 hours.
dont: Thank you for your asking about the prices.
doo: Thank you for your inquiry about our prices.

upgrade.plain: Today I will talk about four things.
pro: Our agenda today will cover four main topics.
Today I will speak in four things.
Today we have four points to say them.
upgrade.why: افتح العرض بـ ‎agenda‎ واضحة: ‎Our agenda today will cover …‎

upgrade.plain: Look at this graph, our sales became more.
upgrade.ar: بصوا على الجراف ده، مبيعاتنا زادت
pro: Look the graph, sales is more.
As you can see from this graph, our sales have steadily increased.
This graph, you see, sales went up up.
upgrade.why: ‎As you can see from this graph‎ بتوجّه عين الجمهور بشكل مهني.

upgrade.plain: Our company is the best and we make everything for the customer.
upgrade.ar: شركتنا الأحسن وبنعمل كل حاجة للعميل
pro: We are the best company and we do all things.
We make everything for all customers.
We pride ourselves on offering solutions tailored to each client's needs.
upgrade.why: بدل ما تقول إحنا الأحسن، قول ‎We pride ourselves on …‎

upgrade.plain: Sorry, I forgot to say something important.
pro: I want to apologize for not mentioning an important detail.
Sorry, I forgot to tell something important.
upgrade.why: ‎apologize for not mentioning‎ اعتذار مهني بدل ‎I forgot‎.

upgrade.plain: The price is fixed, there is no extra money after.
upgrade.ar: السعر ثابت ومفيش فلوس زيادة بعدين
pro: The price is fixed and no more money after.
No extra money will come later.
There are no hidden fees or charges.
upgrade.why: ‎no hidden fees or charges‎ بتطمّن العميل إن مفيش مفاجآت.

upgrade.plain: If you have any question, ask me.
pro: If you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to ask me.
If there is questions, you can asking me.
upgrade.why: ‎please do not hesitate to‎ أدب وترحيب بالأسئلة.
